levels.surface: أبو جعفر محمد ابن علي بن الحسين بن موسى بن بابويه القمي

notes: The Imam speaks inside the narrator's story («فرفع (عليه السلام) يده ... فقال: يا رب»), so he is the last link after «أبيه» (owner ruling 5); the surface is the name the text gives him.
Fadl ibn al-Rabi' speaks and addresses the narrator inside the same scene; he is in the story, not the last link. «الشيخ الفقيه» and «(4)» are titles and marks and are left out.
